image_title: Comparison of Scores in AIME and MATH
summary: This bar chart compares scores in two assessments, AIME and MATH, across different categories. The left section displays scores for TTRL and various 'No Code' categories, with TTRL achieving a score of 20.0 in AIME and 73.6 in MATH. The middle section shows the same 'No Code' categories, with scores of 18.3 for AIME and 73.1 for MATH. The right section introduces a new category, 'With Code', showing a score of 21.7 in AIME and 74.9 in MATH. The data indicates a trend where the 'With Code' category outperforms the 'No Code' categories in both assessments, highlighting the impact of coding on performance.
